content.comment_body: Is anyone able to help me connect a [product_name] with a Delta DOP-107EG HMI? My understanding of communication protocols is quite basic. Thank you.
The [product_name] supports communication over Ethernet TCP/IP using the S7 protocol or Modbus TCP/IP. Can the Delta HMI handle either of these?
I believe so. These are the settings I've tried. (I attempted to use S7 TCP-IP, but it wasn't accepted.)
"The pulse and interpulse should be set from the Delta HMI." I'm unsure what you mean. Do you currently have a functional connection to the HMI or not?

No, I don't have a working connection yet. I'm still figuring out the implementation. I tried setting it up, but couldn't proceed further because I haven't finished the program (as mentioned in my question from '[product_name] - Projects').

Are you intending to purchase an HMI without knowing its communication capabilities? I'm not familiar with the Delta HMI model. From my knowledge: [product_name] supports Ethernet TCP/IP with the S7 protocol as well as Modbus TCP/IP.
That's not what I meant. I don't plan to buy an HMI. This is the device I need to work with, if it's suitable.
If you have to work with the Delta HMI, can you clarify: Does the Delta HMI support Ethernet TCP/IP or Modbus TCP/IP? [product_name] is only compatible with Modbus TCP/IP, not Modbus RTU.

Hello, Have you tried searching online? Within ten minutes I found an example on YouTube showing Delta HMI with [company_name] [product_name]. See this link, which may help ([url]). PART 1 and PART 2 demonstrate the connection process.

analysis.insight_summary: The main issue is that users lack clear guidance for integrating a [product_name] device with a Delta HMI. Protocol compatibility (S7 TCP/IP vs. Modbus TCP/IP) is a major concern, especially for users with limited networking experience. There's uncertainty regarding the HMI's supported protocols and specific steps needed for a working connection. Users also struggle to apply available examples and documentation to their own setup.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking simple, clear instructions to establish communication between a [product_name] and a Delta HMI, confirming protocol compatibility and achieving a reliable setup. Concise, step-by-step guidance is valued, as the user has little prior experience in this area.
